black_cover_full.glyph_bbox: Glyph boxes are font-metric boxes. pdfium sizes them from its own ascent/descent (and, for non-embedded base-14 fonts, its own substitute fonts) where MuPDF used its fonts; x extents agree, heights differ by up to ~2 pt. Removal still requires the fill to cover the glyph ink box, which pdfium measures from the glyph outline, so safety does not rest on this box.
black_cover_full.visibility_state: A later opaque fill covers the glyph ink and the MuPDF metric box but not pdfium's taller base-14 substitute metric box, so the glyph is held (partial occlusion) instead of removed. More conservative; no glyph the goldens kept is removed.
black_cover_full.visible_text: Follows from visibility_state: the glyph stays in the visible candidate text.
